atoms.proposition: the donor has paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the tax year of the donation as the amount of Gift Aid claimed
the donor has made a valid Gift Aid declaration that gives the charity permission to claim Gift Aid
the donation is not made through Payroll Giving
the donation is not a payment for goods or services or made because the charity bought goods and services
the donation does not provide the donor with a benefit that exceeds a certain limit
the donation is not from a charity card or vouchers such as Charities Aid Foundation (CAF) vouchers
the charity is recognised as a charity or CASC for tax purposes

limitations: The tax year of the donation is not established; the donor's tax document covers a prior year and no current-year tax evidence is available.
The Gift Aid declaration is incomplete; the page stating its coverage and duration is missing.
The policy does not specify whether a donation made for an emergency appeal qualifies as a benefit or a service payment, or whether it falls under the 'benefit' exception.
scope_issues: The policy applies to individual donations, but does not specify whether one-off donations or recurring donations are treated differently in eligibility.
